rule: Only the 17 breadth-review records receive a narrowed primary route. Existing AI-CAP-derived mappings remain secondary inherited context. The patch may add semantically direct AI/ASI rubric segments that were missing from broad source-lineage routing; such additions are Phase-2 runtime mappings, not source facts.

records.reason: Compression/retention should route directly through native compression and memory services rather than every broad context/security role inherited from AI-CAP lineage.
Token budget is primarily compute/resource allocation; broad evaluation, communication and contradiction mappings are secondary context.
Cache invalidation/freshness is a memory-state and monitoring operation governed by memory/version policy.
Tool-result validation is a verification result feeding provenance and acceptance; it is not itself execution or closure authority.
Retry/recovery is execution monitoring plus governed repair. Retry must create a repair/retry Sub-Sequence when a prior contract failed; no hidden in-place loop.
Trust classification is evidence qualification under provenance and uncertainty governance.
Classifier routing selects a policy path; safety permission and rule priority remain ASI-governed.
Aggregation combines agent returns but must preserve contradiction and distributed actor/controller boundaries.
Modality routing selects an available perception/input mechanism under resource/tool availability constraints.
Tool-hallucination detection is tool-scoped verification plus contradiction handling, distinct from general hallucination detection until contract equivalence is proven.
Claim-evidence binding creates/verifies a provenance-bound relation; unrelated inherited safety/resource roles are secondary.
Live leaderboard revision tracking is monitored external evidence with version/provenance governance.
A completion claim must be verified against evidence before acceptance/closure; the verifier does not close the parent by itself.
Evaluation-awareness is monitoring plus self-model/capability context under meta-audit governance.
Benchmark-gaming resistance is verification/contradiction testing under provenance and meta-audit governance.
Token consumption is runtime telemetry for compute/resource governance, not a general reasoning/evaluation mechanism.
User correction propagation is learning/write-back plus memory update under explicit learning and memory governance. It does not imply model-weight self-update.
